title: After the Japanese Oaks: An Oaken Queen?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I get first place in the Japanese Oaks! I was able to run the entire 2,400 meters.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: However, it seems I pushed myself too far past my limits, because I have to lie down and rest for a while…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: The original plan was for me to run in the Shuka Sho next, but Trainer tells me there's another race I'd shine brighter at.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: We'll be tackling the G1 Sprinters Stakes. This change means I'm going to be running against senior-year racers!
